summary: Risk rating MEDIUM: On-lending through an NBFC with priority sector treatment.

transaction.description: NBFC lending transaction requiring priority sector reporting

findings.title: On-lending through an NBFC with priority sector treatment
findings.rationale: NBFCs have no priority sector targets of their own, so the obligation sits with the lending bank through the on-lending route.
required_actions: Confirm per-borrower eligibility and obtain disaggregated data with auditor certification.
Include the loan in quarterly priority sector reporting within 15 days after quarter end.
